messages:
Claire: Quick design check — noticed the new in-product help drawer (top-right ?) uses 'Docs' in one place and 'Guides' in another. Confusing for users who just want an explanation of routing policies. Can we pick one term?
Sam: Agree. I vote for 'Docs' because it's consistent with our public site. Also the drawer link goes to the generic docs homepage, not the specific routing policy section. :confused: 
Mike: Re: linking — can we make the inline drawer include deep links to doc anchors (e.g., /docs/routing#policy-fallbacks) instead of the root? Keeps context.
Anita: UX nit — the drawer's keyboard focus is trapped but there is no aria-label on the close button. Screen readers read it as 'button' only. Small a11y fix.
Claire: Good catches. High-level ask: unify terminology to 'Docs' across console strings, and add 1-click deep links from the drawer to the relevant doc section. Also adjust CTA label from 'Learn more' to 'Open docs (in new tab)' when it opens a new tab.
Sam: I'm worried about clicking away — currently the link opens in-app which loses console state. I'd prefer new tab. We should surface that in the tooltip: 'Opens docs in new tab'.
Mike: For implementation, propose adding an optional query param that lets the docs page scroll to an anchor and include a small back link to console. e.g.:
```
https://docs.redwood.inference/guides/routing?anchor=policy-fallbacks&console_return=true
```
That lets us show a subtle 'Back to Console' banner on docs.
Anita: For copy: instead of 'Docs' maybe we could use 'Docs & Guides' as the drawer header? It communicates breadth. But I don't like inconsistent microcopy. If we change headers, update nav labels too.
doc-bot: automated note: there are 4 UI strings referencing 'Guides' in the console bundle (ui/help_drawer.title, ui/help_cta.label, ui/route_explain.header, ui/route_explain.link_text).
Claire: Thanks @doc-bot. Action items: Sam will PR copy changes (replace 'Guides' -> 'Docs' except for public marketing pages), Mike will add deep-link format and console_return param, Anita will send a11y checklist for the drawer, and I'll update the design spec. Can we get these done in this sprint? :calendar:
Sam: I'll open the PR tonight and tag reviewers. Will add tests ensuring the CTA text includes '(opens in new tab)' when target=_blank.
Mike: I'll stub the docs return banner — will need a small OIDC-safe param check. Punting details to infra if needed.
Anita: Checklist notes: close button needs aria-label="Close help drawer", focus should move to the triggering element after close, and the drawer header should be an h2. Small CSS: increase focus ring contrast.
Claire: Perfect. One more thing — let's add an inline micro-link from the main routes table row to the drawer so users can get contextual help without leaving the page. E.g., a '?' icon with aria-describedby.
Sam: Good idea. I'll make the icon 16px and add a tooltip text 'View documentation for this route'.
Mike: tagging @docs-team for the deep link anchors — would be great if you can create stable anchor IDs for the sections we reference.
Claire: OK, thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the updated spec and copy list in this thread. :thumbsup:
